decision_summary: QIF v0.6.18 Doctor CLI is release-ready.
rationale: The change composes existing structural checks into one canonical health command, keeps open-risk output non-blocking visibility, preserves verifier boundaries, and passed doctor, validation, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.18 and keep external CI adapters, semantic remediation, and empirical calibration for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can run one command to inspect QIF repository health before release decisions.
